system.description: When you deal unarmed damage to a creature as a result of an attack, you can spend 1 Martial Die to force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are pushed back a number of feet equal to 5 times the result. Beginning at 7th level, you can spend 2 dice increasing the distance pushed and at 13th level, you can spend 3 dice. If a pushed creatures movement would be stopped by a solid structure or objected, they and the object/structure take 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 5 feet of movement the affected creature did not move.

activities.label: Forceful Strike
activities.text: When you deal unarmed damage with an attack. 1 Martial Die (2 from 7th, 3 from 13th level).

roll.note: Feet pushed on a failed save; if a structure stops it, it and the structure take 1d6 bludgeoning per 5 ft short.
